t: This is Stamford Brook House, along with the wall that belongs to it, a listed building in Hounslow. The record I have is thin, so I'll keep it short. John Frere the Third, who lived from 1792 to 1864, owned the property. He appears in the Legacies of British Slave-ownership database, which documents people connected to slave ownership in Britain. That connection is part of the story of who held this house and the land around it.
